title: Pre-soft-s archive audit for an independent rank-one embedding principle
question: Before the later soft-s obstruction was known, did the archived C8/C9 RTK stack already contain an independently motivated action-level principle that uniquely fixes the field map, symmetric potential/algebraic data and action-derived source direction inside the rank-one one-pole class?
required_checks: C8 archive explicitly states its Dirac-degenerate construction is quadratic/scoped rather than a final covariant completion
C8 archive explicitly lists full FLRW lapse/shift embedding and deriving source direction from the same action as future work
C8 one-pole matching is pointwise through kappa and Q and does not uniquely fix the potential matrix
C9 technical-naturalness material does not source-lock the missing rank-one field map, potential matrix and source direction
C9 UV/O4 material does not source-lock the missing rank-one field map, potential matrix and source direction
no post-soft-s material may be used as a selecting principle

decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_PRINCIPLE_FOUND_PASS_SCOPED: Only if a pre-soft-s archived action/symmetry principle uniquely fixes all missing embedding data without fitting any later failed soft-s observable.
decision_rule.NO_INDEPENDENT_PRINCIPLE_FOUND_PASS_SCOP: If the pre-soft-s archive leaves at least one of field map, potential/algebraic data or action-derived source direction explicitly open. Keep s6fT blocked.

scope: Source-identifiability audit only. Failure to find a principle is not a no-go for RTK or for rank-one embeddings; it means the archive does not justify selecting one full nonlinear action.
